items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: T-Bone would get on the show and they'd throw all kinds -- twenty-dollar bills, I was pretty honest -- boy from Texas -- on me, and I took up the change and the bills every day and I'd meet him backstage and I was director of the show

ctx.x: We went in for a month with a month option, and the band was so great until they picked up the month option. Tiny Bradshaw was to come in -- Charlie Fokes, a baritone saxophone player who is with Basie now, has got a kitchenette, getting ready to set up to cook, while they're going to be there for a month ... and it didn't work out that way, because we were doing too much business. They had them roped off in front. The band from Texas -- we had a Texas map, and during that time the song, "Deep in the Heart of…
we had to get Chicago musicians to fill their spot.
